title: 第2000章 击杀轮回道尊第1999章 四象神兽
lines: 第2000章击杀轮回道尊
此刻，陈默体内世界，五行之力复苏，阴阳二气流动于整个五行世界，要席卷每一寸空间，衍生了轮回之力，陈默也变得强大了。
一尊尊虚影从四面八方而来，这些虚影都是陈默的各种法则之力所化，包含了雷电、虚空、生死等元素之力，使得虚影世界变得完整了。
“从此就让这世界和外界一样，拥有同样的时间流速和各种法则之力，我陈默乃是这世界的主人，不再是主神强者，而是主宰级别人物。”
陈默体外有三千大道衍生，各种法则之力百花争鸣，五行世界不断涌现出陈默的分身，这些分身都各自游荡五行世界，将自身的法则之力铺洒在每一个角落。
在仙界游历无数年，陈默已然掌控了各种法则之力，其中包括时间法则、空间法则、虚空法则、生死法则、光明法则和雷电法则。
这些法则之力都让陈默的实力变得空前绝后的强大。
轰隆隆！
随着法则之力扩散之际，整个四面八方传来一阵动荡，陈默的脸上不由浮现一抹笑容，五行自成世界，他将会是这个世界的主宰，主宰三千大道，主宰五行世界的一花一草，他们的性命都归陈默掌控。
只要陈愿意，五行世界任何一人他的可以击杀。
嗡！
忽然间，外界传来一阵毁灭的力量，陈默心浮动，忍不住抬头看向外界所在的位置，“轮回道尊终于破封而出了吗？”
“我自成主宰，正好看轮回道尊的实力到底有多强。”
陈默一步跨出，离开了五行世界。
而在这时，几头神兽对付轮回道尊，不过他们的修为根本起不到作用，毕竟轮回道尊的实力何等强大，他很快就打败这些强者。
“你们这些人根本不是我对手，给我死来。”轮回道尊抬起手掌便是强大的轮回之力，伴随着玄力翻腾，整个空间有沉重的威压。
感受到这个情况，洞天帝主眉头一皱，如果这些神兽也无法对付轮回道尊，那么他们这些人战力不足，迟早会死在轮回道尊手里。
不止是她！
其余人也知道事情的严重性，轮回道尊的战斗力强大非凡。
对付轮回道尊，简直如同登天。
可在这时，陈默从虚空迈步而来，他望着在场的所有强者都下意识眨眨眼，眸子闪动之际，划过一抹无比认真的神色。
“轮回道尊，你已经突破天尊，实力是至上，为何还要在这里滥杀无辜？”
“陈默，你终于来了？”
轮回道尊转身望着陈默，冷冷说道：“上次因你一事，我无法突破天尊境界，所以才会进入宇宙之眼，如今我要自然要对付你陈默。”
听了这话，陈默下意识眨眨眼。
“既然如此，你我之间只要一战，主宰苍生的命运。”
陈默君临天下的光芒横扫而过，使得轮回道尊的心头都是狠狠抽搐。
“陈默，你这是已经踏入主宰之王了吗？”轮回道尊平静说道。
他知道陈默有五行世界，不过这个世界想孕育出主宰之王却是非常困难，其中不但需要轮回之力，光明法则，还要有阴阳二气。
只是，轮回道尊并不知道，陈默还有混沌体，相当于他还有混沌之力。
“轮回道尊，给我死来。”
陈默眉心浮现晦涩难懂的梵文，伴随着玄力涌动，旋即便是有一道轮回之光涌动而出，瞬间便是呈现第三只眼，这只眼比陈默另外两个眼睛还要强大，透着一股锋芒毕露的气息，使得空间变得异常沉重。
“这是轮回眼？”望着陈默出现的第三只眼，轮回道尊的心当场震颤一下。
轮回眼，夺天地造化，有如渊如海的威力。
见到这样的轮回眼，轮回道尊内心复杂，虽然他被人称之为轮回道尊，但并没有掌控轮回眼，陈默却有轮回眼，轮回道尊的心头自然是感概万千。
咔嚓！
而在这时，轮回眼带着摄魂夺魄的目光洞穿而出，那光华带着俾倪天下之意，王者无双之威，使得整个空间都充满狂暴之力。
下方，众强见此，均是瞪大眼睛，死死盯着此刻的陈默，他们已经看出陈默不同以往的强大，整个人透露出来的战斗力异常可怕。
见到这样的陈默，即便是洞天大帝也意想不到，但她知道有陈默在就能对付轮回道尊。
此刻的轮回道尊稍微蹙眉，划过凝重之色，旋即他便是手持轮回剑向陈默斩杀而来，这把轮回剑在轮回道尊的手里绽放更加可怕的威力。

Chapter 2000 Killing Samsara Taoist Master
At this moment, in the world inside Chen Mo, the power of the Five Elements revived. Yin and Yang qi flowed through the entire Five Elements world, sweeping every inch of space. This gave rise to the power of reincarnation, and Chen Mo became stronger.
Shadows come from all directions. These shadows are transformed by the power of Chen Mo's various laws, including the power of thunder and lightning, void, life and death, etc., making the world of shadows complete.
"From now on, let this world be the same as the outside world, with the same flow of time and the power of various laws. I, Chen Mo, am the master of this world. I am no longer a powerful master god, but a dominator-level figure."
There are three thousand avenues derived from Chen Mo's body, and the power of various laws is blooming. Chen Mo's clones are constantly emerging in the Five Elements World. These clones are wandering around the Five Elements World, spreading the power of their own laws in every corner.
After traveling in the fairy world for countless years, Chen Mo has mastered the power of various laws, including the laws of time, space, void, life and death, light and thunder.
The power of these laws made Chen Mo's strength unprecedentedly powerful.
Boom!
As the power of the law spread, there was a turmoil in all directions. A smile appeared on Chen Mo's face. The five elements formed a world of their own. He would be the master of this world, dominate the three thousand avenues, and dominate every flower and grass in the five elements world. Their lives were all under Chen Mo's control.
As long as Chen is willing, he can kill anyone in the Five Elements World.
Buzz!
Suddenly, a burst of destructive power came from the outside world. Chen Mo was heartbroken and couldn't help but look up at the location of the outside world. "Has Samsara Dao Master finally broken through the seal and come out?"
"I have become my own master, just to see how strong Samsara Taoist Master is."
Chen Mo took a step forward and left the Five Elements World.
At this time, several divine beasts dealt with Samsara Taoist Master, but their cultivation had no effect at all. After all, Samsara Taoist Master was so powerful that he quickly defeated these strong men.
"You guys are no match for me at all. Come and die." Reverend Samsara Taoist raised his palm to reveal the powerful power of reincarnation. As the profound energy surged, the entire space felt heavy pressure.
Sensing this situation, the Dongtian Emperor frowned. If these divine beasts could not deal with Samsara Taoist, then these people were not strong enough and would die in the hands of Samsara Taoist sooner or later.
It's not just her!
The rest of the people also knew the seriousness of the matter, and the fighting power of Samsara Dao Zun was extremely powerful.
Dealing with Samsara Taoist Master is like ascending to heaven.
But at this moment, Chen Mo stepped forward from the void. He looked at all the powerful men present and blinked subconsciously. When his eyes flashed, there was an extremely serious look.
"Samsara Taoist Master, you have already broken through to the Heavenly Master, and your strength is supreme. Why are you still killing innocent people here?"
"Chen Mo, are you finally here?"
Reincarnation Taoist Master turned around and looked at Chen Mo, and said coldly: "Last time, because of you, I was unable to break through to the realm of Heavenly Master, so I entered the Eye of the Universe. Now I have to deal with you, Chen Mo."
After hearing this, Chen Mo blinked subconsciously.
"In this case, there is only one battle between you and me to control the fate of the people."
Chen Mo's rays of light swept across the world, causing Samsara Taoist Master's heart to twitch violently.
"Chen Mo, have you already stepped into the King of Dominance?" Samsara Taoist Master said calmly.
He knew that Chen Mo had a world of five elements, but it was very difficult to give birth to the king of domination in this world, which required not only the power of reincarnation, the law of light, but also the two qi of yin and yang.
However, Samsara Taoist Master didn't know that Chen Mo still had a Chaos Body, which meant that he still had the power of Chaos.
"Samsara Taoist Lord, come and die."
Obscure Sanskrit words appeared between Chen Mo's brows, and with the surge of profound energy, a ray of light of reincarnation surged out, and instantly a third eye appeared. This eye was more powerful than Chen Mo's other two eyes, and exuded a sharp aura, making the space extremely heavy.
"Is this the Samsara Eye?" Looking at Chen Mo's third eye, Samsara Taoist's heart trembled on the spot.
The Eye of Reincarnation has the power to capture the creation of heaven and earth, as powerful as the abyss or the sea.
Seeing such a reincarnation eye, Taoist Samsara's heart was complicated. Although he was called Taoist Samsara, he did not control the eye of reincarnation. Chen Mo did have the eye of reincarnation. Taoist Samsara's heart was naturally full of emotions.
Click!
At this moment, the Samsara Eye penetrated with a soul-stirring gaze. The brilliance carried the meaning of blessing the world, and the unparalleled power of the king made the entire space full of violent power.
Seeing this, all the powerful people below stared at Chen Mo with their eyes wide open. They had already seen that Chen Mo was different from the past, and the combat power revealed by his whole body was extremely terrifying.
Even the Dongtian Emperor was not expecting to see Chen Mo like this, but she knew that with Chen Mo around, she could deal with Samsara Taoist Master.
At this moment, the Taoist Master of Samsara frowned slightly, with a solemn look on his face, and soon he came to kill Chen Mo with the Samsara Sword. This sword of Samsara bloomed with even more terrifying power in the hands of the Taoist Master of Samsara.
title_en: Chapter 2000: Killing the Taoist Master of Samsara Chapter 1999: The Four-Elephant Divine Beast
